conclusion_zh: 本机 DDR 已与 GDDR 共用 DRAM 物理内核；CPU 缓存后的读写和主存 DMA 参与实际事件调度。两个原始 GGUF 场景完整完成，精度仍受未标定参数和其他已知覆盖缺口影响。
changes: Route CPU post-cache logical backing reads and writebacks to shared DramCore; retain CPU pipeline/cache demands and remove legacy transaction padding and backing service.
Keep the HostMemoryProfile analytical energy coefficient and bill it once against resolved physical burst bytes.
Resolve host DMA at attached DDR and, when unambiguous, GPU memory endpoints; keep controller/link path and allocator-bound addresses.
Scope allocation extent promotion by physical owner as well as buffer and generation.
Enable a capacity/bandwidth-consistent physical DDR configuration in the local Acer preset; leave unmeasured organization/timing parameters explicitly analytical.
Preserve legacy scenarios without physical memory configuration, exclude NAND from CPU DRAM hook, and preserve ambiguous multi-backend GPU controller endpoints.

analytical_assumptions: 8 bank groups per rank × 4 banks per group
65536 rows per bank × 8192 bytes per row
14 ns open/close and command-to-data delays; 15 ns write recovery
metadata.assumption_source: Representative DDR5 geometry in tools/measure_memory_precision.py, adjusted to match this machine's measured aggregate capacity and interface
metadata.burst_interval_basis: 64-byte payload / (5600 MT/s × 64 bits / 8) per channel; analytical lane scheduling interval, not a disclosed command timing
metadata.capacity_basis: 2 channels × 4 equivalent ranks/channel × 8 groups/rank × 4 banks/group × 65536 rows/bank × 8192 bytes/row
metadata.cpu_visible_latency_ns: HostMemoryProfile remains 100 ns; it is not a DRAM command timing

verification.frontend_api: POST /api/normalize on refreshed port 8765 preserves DDR, 128 GiB and 89.6 GB/s in hardware_input contract v2
verification.full_run_protocol: Same actual GGUF models, llama mapping, one request, 512 input tokens, 128 output tokens; original source-derived storage contract preserved
verification.native_reference: Reuse native_comparison_2026-10-07 measured five-sample medians; no new native benchmark and no timing fitted to them

accuracy.change_definition: 100 * (new_simulation_ns / previous_simulation_ns - 1); a model change, not a measured accuracy error
limitations: DDR bank/rank/row/burst mapping and command timings are analytical equivalents, not SPD/JEDEC/native trace calibration.
CPU caches keep their existing analytical traffic model; physical DRAM addresses are allocator-bound analytical layouts, not captured native addresses.
Existing omissions such as unbound native host output/sampling contracts and DRAM refresh modeling are not filled by this change.
Full runs validate DDR timing/address integration; the final energy-preservation change has zero timing delta in the final smoke test and separate demand/energy conservation regressions.

dram.accounting_semantics: resolved analytical burst bytes and controller waits; no device accuracy claim

cases.wall_seconds_scope: client submission through completion observation; includes a 20-second polling interval, not a controlled performance benchmark
